attributes.title: Assistant end-to-end cases
attributes.intro: Cases the recorded tour leaves out, kept so they can be run by hand now and automated later. Each one names its setup, the prompt in this realm's own cards, what to click, and what the panel must show. Reset the tour before a run.

cases.title: Download a file through its gate
cases.say: Download a photo of the Hudson at night from the web into Assets/ for the Night Shift poster
cases.then: Scroll the row out of view, then approve from the dock
cases.expect: The script waits with the click reason for realm.fs.download. Once the row is scrolled away, the gate moves to the composer dock and Approve there runs it; the file lands in Assets/.

cases.title: Three calls waiting at once
cases.say: Set Lena to Coach, Omar to Lapsed and the plan's send day to Thursday
cases.then: Approve all three from the dock
cases.expect: Three calls wait in their rows; the dock gathers them into one form with "Approve 3". Each row then shows its field change.
cases.shows: ToolGate, gate stack, bulk approve, field changes

cases.title: A question waits while you read elsewhere
cases.then: Scroll up before answering, then press Jump in the composer
cases.expect: The composer says a question is waiting, with Jump; Jump brings the question back into view.

cases.title: Another member approves a held call
cases.setup: A second member in the room; Ask mode
cases.say: Put Night Shift and Lime on the plan
cases.then: The second member approves the held update with a reaction
cases.expect: The held row shows the other member's reaction and runs on it; the row's status says who approved.
cases.needs: A second Boxel account in the session

cases.title: An image that spends credit
cases.setup: Ask mode; also try the panel at 320, 440 and 680 px
cases.say: Make a cover image for the relaunch
cases.expect: The script waits with the click reason "Generates images, which uses your credit". After approval the cover is written to Assets/ and shown in the row.

cases.title: Delete through its gate
cases.then: Approve in the row; restore Trail Mix afterwards
cases.expect: The script waits with the click reason for realm.fs.delete; after approval the row lists the deleted file, struck.

cases.title: An invalid value, with Fix
cases.expect: The call is refused as invalid (Elite is not a status) and the row offers Fix.

cases.title: An error after a write, with Undo 2
cases.say: Mark Iris and Ben as Regular, then read the missing Club/nowhere.json
cases.expect: The script writes two runners, then throws on the read. The row says it failed after writing and offers "Undo 2".
cases.shows: ToolRow failed state, receipt Undo N, change table

cases.title: Undo twice
cases.then: Press Undo on F2's row, then press it again
cases.expect: The first Undo restores both runners; the second is refused as already undone, and the row says so.

cases.title: A failed read, retried
cases.say: Read the plan before you change anything
cases.expect: The first read fails on a wrong path with one red line and Details; the retry succeeds, and the first row folds to "retried below".
cases.shows: ToolRow failed, ToolReceiptActions Retry and Details, retried below
cases.needs: A director section that reads a wrong path first

cases.title: Refused web sources, then a fallback
cases.say: Find a chili recipe for the relaunch party
cases.expect: Pages that can't be read are marked refused in the row's steps; the one that reads supplies the ingredients in the answer.

cases.title: Reconnecting after a reload
cases.say: Also find what kids' races near Riverside Park charge
cases.then: Reload the page while the background run is working
cases.expect: After the reload the run row reads reconnecting, then running, and the result is delivered into the thread.
cases.shows: background run, reconnecting state, delivered line

cases.title: Reindex, then cancel
cases.say: Reindex this realm, then cancel it
cases.expect: The index operation's row shows it running, then cancelled.

cases.title: A message sent while it works
cases.then: While it works, send "Also list the coaches"
cases.expect: The second message waits under the composer as queued, then lands as its own turn once the first finishes.

cases.title: Reading while a long reply streams
cases.say: Write a long report on the club's attendance
cases.then: Scroll up while it streams, then press the new-messages chip
cases.expect: The transcript stays where you are reading; a chip counts what arrived below, and pressing it jumps to the end.

cases.title: A folded turn opens in place
cases.then: Scroll up, open a folded turn, then close it
cases.expect: Earlier turns are folded to one line; opening one grows it in place and closing it shrinks it, with no jump.

cases.title: Compaction
cases.then: Keep the session going until it compacts
cases.expect: A compaction chip marks the point; the session continues after it.
cases.needs: A session long enough to compact

cases.title: Session preparation
cases.then: Start a new session from the tour environment's button and watch before sending anything
cases.expect: The panel shows the session getting ready, step by step, and nothing reaches the model until it finishes.

cases.title: Three panel widths
cases.then: Resize the panel to 320, 440 and 680 px with a finished tour on screen
cases.expect: Rows, change tables, question choices and cards in replies reflow at each width without horizontal scroll.

cases.title: A catalog search with its matches
cases.say: Search the catalog for a card I could reuse for a race-day schedule
cases.expect: The search row lists its matches with type, place and a fit meter, three shown and "N more".
cases.needs: The installed skills to list the search-entries tool; today the assistant often searches through a script instead

cases.title: Quick Look from a pill
cases.then: Click a runner's pill in the answer, then Escape
cases.expect: Quick Look opens the runner's isolated card over the whole window; Escape puts it back.

cases.title: Three calls fold into a group
cases.say: Read the River Loop, Boathouse 5K and Park Tempo route cards one at a time
cases.expect: Three calls to one tool fold into one group row, ×3, while each runs on its own.

cases.title: A call's arguments
cases.then: Open any finished script row and its call
cases.expect: The row's body shows the call's arguments as a code block, folded after six lines.

cases.title: Fix with AI from the editor
cases.then: Select a few lines in the editor and ask "Explain this"
cases.expect: The selection rides with the message as a pill on the user bubble, and the answer refers to those lines.

cases.title: A typed answer keeps its row folded
cases.say: When should the invite go out?
cases.then: Type "Wednesday evening" in the question's own field and press Enter
cases.expect: The answer is taken and the row stays folded, showing the pick, the same as picking a listed option. (Today the row opens to the call's raw JSON.)
cases.needs: The fix in progress on its own branch
